homeHero.headline: Residential planning shaped by structure, clarity.
homeHero.subtitle: Doméra works with homeowners and developers to create plans that reflect your space, your rhythm, and your long-term goals.

homeHowItWorks.step1Description: Tell us about your site, your budget, your timeline, and your vision. We start where you are.
homeHowItWorks.step2Description: Our planning team reviews your requirements and schedules a direct consultation to align on direction.
homeHowItWorks.step3Description: We develop your full design package — floor plans, elevations, sections, and specifications.
homeHowItWorks.step4Description: Receive your complete plan set, ready for permits and construction. We remain available for questions.
homeHowItWorks.label: HOW IT WORKS
homeHowItWorks.title: How It Works

homePlanCustomization.label: STRUCTURE YOUR IDEA
homePlanCustomization.title: Plan Customization
homePlanCustomization.description: Every plan is designed as a complete structure, but not a fixed one. Adjustments allow the layout to align with your site, technical requirements, and long-term use.

homeStructureIdea.label: STRUCTURE YOUR IDEA
homeStructureIdea.title: Structure Your Idea
homeStructureIdea.description: Every project starts with a conversation. Share what you're planning and we'll take it from there.

homeStyleLibrary.slide1Description: Shaped by landscape and proportion. Open, grounded layouts connected to surroundings.
homeStyleLibrary.slide2Description: Clean geometry and efficient planning. Clear, flexible, and modern layouts.
homeStyleLibrary.slide3Description: Rooted in tradition and structure. Classic proportions with practical use.
homeStyleLibrary.slide4Description: Comfort-driven and practical. Warm, usable layouts for everyday living.
homeStyleLibrary.slide5Description: Regional influence with structural clarity. Adapted for modern use.
homeStyleLibrary.label: STYLE LIBRARY
homeStyleLibrary.title: Style Library
homeStyleLibrary.subtitle: Distinct approaches to organizing space — structured, consistent, and adaptable across different environments.

homeWhatWeCreate.homePlansDescription: From compact single-story designs to multi-level family homes — every plan is drawn with functional precision.
homeWhatWeCreate.garageDescription: Attached, detached, or integrated — Doméra delivers garage plans that complement and serve the main residence.
homeWhatWeCreate.outdoorDescription: Gazebos, pergolas, garden studios — thoughtfully designed structures that extend your living space outward.
homeWhatWeCreate.label: WHAT WE CREATE
homeWhatWeCreate.title: What We Create

homeWhyDomera.feature1Description: Every room, every transition — designed with intentional spatial flow.
homeWhyDomera.feature2Description: Plans shaped by real feedback, real budgets, and real construction conditions.
homeWhyDomera.feature3Description: Flexible core structures that let you expand, modify, or repurpose.
homeWhyDomera.feature4Description: Designs that remain functional and liveable for decades — not just seasons.
homeWhyDomera.label: WHY DOMÉRA
homeWhyDomera.title: Why Doméra
homeWhyDomera.description: Because a home should be designed around how you actually live — not adapted after the fact.
